job.title: Sr. UX Researcher, Applied AI Solutions
job.location: Sunnyvale, CA · Seattle, WA · Arlington, VA · New York, NY · Herndon, VA
job.summary: Lead user research for AWS’s AI-native business applications. Use qualitative and quantitative studies to inform product direction, improve usability, and understand adoption and trust.
highlights: Requires 5+ years leading user research and hands-on experience across field studies, testing, and surveys.
Requires a relevant bachelor’s degree and portfolio of research plans, reports, or other deliverables.
Partner with design, engineering, and applied science; explore AI-assisted research methods.
